diagnosis: Account is on the startup plan with basic support tier, which does not entitle the audit log feature. The 403 error aligns with the knowledge base article on feature availability by plan tier.
reply:
Hello,

Thank you for reaching out. A 403 error on the audit log endpoint typically indicates that the feature is not included in your current plan tier. Based on your account details, the audit log feature is available on Standard and Premium support tiers, and your current plan does not include this entitlement.

If you believe your permissions should have changed, please review your plan details and consider upgrading to a tier that includes audit logs.

Best regards,
Support Desk
